cards.title: Answer Jonah's API rate limit question
cards.body: Their nightly sync gets 429 errors after about 3,000 requests. A short answer with the limit and a fix.

next_action.subject: Re: Rate limit on the contacts endpoint?
next_action.label: Send to Jonah
next_action.body:
Hi Jonah,

The contacts endpoint allows 600 requests a minute per API key. Past that it answers 429 with a Retry-After header, so waiting that many seconds and going on is enough.

With 100 contacts per page your sync stays under the limit with a short pause every 600 pages. Or use the bulk export, which needs one request for everything.

Alex
